audit.whatIsWrong: wants.foe[1] credits Teemo's move speed to a 'movespeed passive', and the page never says what the blind actually costs Locke.
audit.why: Move Quick is his W (14s), passive until a champion or turret hits him, with an active sprint that survives being struck. His passive is Guerrilla Warfare: invisible indefinitely when he stands still, and invisible while MOVING inside brush, with an attack-speed burst on leaving stealth — which makes facechecking a bush a genuine death sentence against a champion with one 425-range escape. Blinding Dart, a flat 7 seconds at 680 range, denies three separate things in one cast: the on-hit passive, the attack that consumes nail marks, and the attack Locke's E lands on arrival.
audit.corrected: Move speed attributed to Move Quick (W); Guerrilla Warfare's brush invisibility added to early; the blind's triple denial spelled out in spikes[0] and wants.foe[0].

edits.before: Skill phase: Teemo's Q (Blinding Dart) shuts off your AA-reliant Silver Stake (P) on-hits, so time your all-in for when his Q is on cooldown and his E (Toxic Shot) poison isn't stacked high.
edits.after: Skill phase: Blinding Dart runs a flat 7 seconds and one cast kills three things — your on-hit damage, the attack that consumes your nail marks, and the attack E lands on arrival. All-in only while it is down.

edits.before: Skill lane early — Teemo's Q (Blinding Dart) is the whole matchup, since a well-timed blind cancels your AA-based Silver Stake (P) on-hits mid-trade. Farm through his E (Toxic Shot) poke and only step up when his Q is on cooldown; his squishiness means any clean trade goes your way.
edits.after: Skill lane early — Teemo's Q (Blinding Dart) is the whole matchup: a well-timed blind cancels every attack your on-hit damage rides on. Never facecheck brush either, since Guerrilla Warfare keeps him invisible while he moves inside it. Step up only while his Q is down; any clean trade goes your way.

edits.before: Through 4-5 it stays even and hinges on his Q timing — eat the blind and you lose the trade, catch it down and you win hard. Use E (Ashen Pursuit) to close before his poison and movespeed let him kite, and lean on W (Soul Ignition) grey-health to survive the approach.
edits.after: Through 4-5 it stays even and hinges on his Q timing — eat the blind and you lose the trade, catch it down and you win hard. Use E (Ashen Pursuit) to close before Move Quick (W) lets him kite out, and lean on W (Soul Ignition) grey-health to survive the approach.

notes: Teemo's move speed is Move Quick (W), not a passive — his passive is Guerrilla Warfare, and its moving invisibility inside brush never appeared on the page despite being the setup for most of his kills against a champion whose only escape is a 425-range dash. The blind's real cost is also now spelled out: it takes the on-hit, the mark consume and the E arrival attack in one 7-second cast. I did not use the enemyKit knockup flag on Noxious Trap — Riot's own text describes only a slow and damage over time, so per the brief I trusted the description.
